name: Guys
source:
Hating to lose, Guys is determined and high-spirited, but is a bit rash and reckless. Falsely accused of murdering a man he hasn't even met by the police, and consequently, the courts, Guys is sent to the prison from hell to serve time.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
